Copy feedback, process alignment, and next landing-page assignment

requirements.title: Expanded Compression Springs Landing-Page Copy
requirements.definition: Produce substantially expanded copy for the Compression Springs landing page according to the supplied outline, excluding separately managed sections.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the overall expanded page-copy deliverable. The Case Study and Innovation and Customization sections are separate because their ownership and content dependencies evolve independently.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi Gordon -- hope you had a good weekend! We are looking to substantially expand page content. Please let me know how this will change your scope and timeline for this copy.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Gordon -- hope you're doing well! I wanted to step back into the conversation to share some of the feedback on the first piece of content. I've linked the Google doc with the client's feedback below.

Most of their edits are based around language and context which we'll collectively learn over time. One additional note I wanted to share based on our edits: For product info pages, we're looking for a more formal tone with fewer interjections and exclamation points.

<https://docs.google.com/document/d/16QxHE4I8PnjCgqCcqeSjj7O4LyFRYFD3MQ6dKYv0c14/edit?usp=sharing>

Overall both our team and the client are happy with the way the piece turned out -- looking forward to seeing the next!

execution.observed_behavior: After reviewing the first completed landing-page piece, both the client's team and the end client report being happy with the result.
